SAMPLE(1)                    User Commands                   SAMPLE(1)

NNAAMMEE
     sample - show a page of text

SSYYNNOOPPSSIISS
     ssaammppllee [--vv] [--ww _w_i_d_t_h] _f_i_l_e...

DDEESSCCRRIIPPTTIIOONN
     ssaammppllee prints each _f_i_l_e to standard output, with “curly quotes”
     and an em—dash.

     A second paragraph that is long enough to wrap onto another line
     at sixty columns.

   OOppttiioonnss
     --vv     Print more.

     --ww _w_i_d_t_h
            Wrap at _w_i_d_t_h columns.

            The default is 80.

     • A bullet.

     • Another bullet.

EEXXAAMMPPLLEESS
     sample -w 40 notes.txt | less
            Indented note.

SSEEEE AALLSSOO
     ccaatt(1), the sample site <https://example.org/sample>.
